seeds.text: When the old identity dies, grief is the right response — even if the old version was hurting you.
Self-awareness isn't watching yourself perform. It's noticing the pattern running you, then choosing to interrupt one move.
When the parts that used to drive you sit down, the Self that was always underneath finally drives.
The hardest part of the hero's journey isn't the descent. It's coming back changed and being asked to live as if you're not.
You don't need a five-year plan. You need the next honest step. The path reveals one step at a time.

slides.composition: A shimmering, incomplete chrome chrysalis, cracked open slightly from within, bathed in soft, ethereal light, conveying delicate emergence.

slides.text: You're grieving a version of yourself you had to leave behind.
slides.composition: A pair of stylized, cel-shaded hands gently cradling a delicate, fragmented glass orb, reflecting a mournful, wistful mood.

slides.text: The world still sees the you you used to be. That gap is exhausting.
slides.composition: A lone, full-body chrome figure, seen from behind, gazing into a vast, misty landscape where a faint, older silhouette shimmers, evoking a sense of alienation.

slides.text: So you dim yourself, trying to fit back in. A subtle self-betrayal.
slides.composition: A blurred dreamcore gradient field with a small, glowing light source slowly fading into shadow at the center, symbolizing internal suppression.

slides.text: The next honest move isn't a grand plan. It's a quiet turning.
slides.composition: An overhead top-down view of a single, small, chrome-plated gear quietly rotating amidst larger, stationary, antique clockwork mechanisms, suggesting subtle internal shift.

slides.text: This quiet turning is how the real you finally starts to drive.
slides.composition: An architectural portal archway framing a serene, star-dusted cosmic vista, with a path leading confidently through its luminous opening, conveying hopeful progression.

slides.text: Let the new truth settle into your bones.
slides.composition: A close-up of a single, glossy, chrome-plated hand resting peacefully on a textured, reflective surface, emanating a soft, grounded glow of acceptance.

caption:
This slow shedding. It’s a real kind of grief. You’re not broken for feeling it. Just remember, your quiet turning is the way forward. Let the real you find its footing.
